title: Chinese Word Segmentation: Jieba Integration for CJK Search
summary: KM uses jieba for Chinese word segmentation, allowing Chinese queries to match Chinese module content with proper word boundaries instead of treating entire sentences as single tokens.

content.overview: English text has natural word boundaries (spaces), so the regex \w+ correctly extracts individual words. Chinese text has no spaces between words — '知识管理系统' is three words ('知识', '管理', '系统') but \w+ captures it as one token. This breaks word-boundary matching, stem matching, and BM25 for any Chinese content. The fix delegates Chinese tokenization to jieba while keeping snowballstemmer for English.
content.details:
IMPLEMENTATION: The _stem() function in storage.py now checks for CJK characters via a regex ([一-鿿㐀-䶿豈-﫿]). If found, it delegates to jieba.cut() which returns space-separated words. _field_stems() then splits this output into individual tokens. Query tokenization in record_search_event() does the same.

Code change in _stem():
- Old: return cast(str, _EN_STEMMER.stemWord(word.lower()))
- New: check _CJK_RE.search(word) → if True, jieba.cut(word) → space-separated tokens; if False, snowballstemmer as before

Code change in _field_stems():
- Old: {_stem(word) for word in _WORD_RE.findall(text)}
- New: split _stem() output on spaces, add each token individually

Code change in record_search_event():
- Old: [_stem(w) for w in _WORD_RE.findall(query.lower())]
- New: flatten jieba output into individual tokens

NO CHANGES NEEDED:
- _WORD_RE (\w+) still correctly captures CJK characters as 'word characters'
- _bm25_scores() already handles space-separated tokens from _stem()
- search_modules() already splits query on spaces
- The snowballstemmer import is kept for English; it's a no-op on jieba output
content.examples:
Before jieba (broken):
  Query '架构决策' → stemmed as ['架构决策'] (one token)
  Module title '知识管理系统架构决策' → stemmed as ['知识管理系统架构决策'] (one token)
  No match because the full strings differ.

After jieba (working):
  Query '架构决策' → jieba → '架构 决策' → tokens ['架构', '决策']
  Module title '知识管理系统架构决策' → jieba → '知识 管理 系统 架构 决策' → tokens ['知识', '管理', '系统', '架构', '决策']
  Match: '架构' and '决策' both found → high relevance score.
content.references: See storage.py:_stem() for the jieba integration. See storage.py:_field_stems() for token splitting. See tests/test_storage.py:test_search_modules_chinese_tokenization for the test.
content.caveats: jieba uses a dictionary-based approach. Specialized technical terms not in the default dictionary may not segment correctly. Users can add custom terms via jieba.add_word(). Chinese stemming is not applied (words are already atomic). Mixed Chinese-English content works correctly because jieba preserves English words as-is within Chinese text. jieba is required by pyproject.toml — if not installed, _stem() falls back to lowercasing the word (graceful degradation).
